Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (Put) (BABA) Holding Has Raised by Indus Capital Partners Llc; As Netflix (NFLX) Share Price Rose, Scopia Capital Management LP Decreased Position by $59.17 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Matt Sirovich decreased its stake in Netflix Inc (NFLX) by 13.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scopia Capital Management Lp sold 309,780 shares as the company’s stock rose 58.31% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Matt Sirovich held 2.04M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $392.34M, down from 2.35 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scopia Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Netflix Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $140.92B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.32% or $1.04 during the last trading session, reaching $324.18. About 2.95 million shares traded. Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 108.73% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.18% the S&P500.
David Kowitz increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Put) (BABA) by 62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Indus Capital Partners Llc bought 31,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by David Kowitz held 81,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.97M, up from 50,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Indus Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.05B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 during the last trading session, reaching $195. About 14.24 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Investors sentiment increased to 1.31 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.19, from 1.12 in 2017Q3. Parallax Volatility Advisers Lp has 30,738 shares for 0.01% of their portfolio. Jpmorgan Chase reported 2.38 million shares or 0.1% of all its holdings. Contravisory Mgmt holds 80 shares or 0.01% of its portfolio. Missouri-based Buckingham Asset Ltd Llc has invested 0.1% in Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX). 120,682 were reported by Fjarde Ap. Analysts await Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) to report earnings on July, 16. They expect $0.80 earnings per share, up 433.33% or $0.65 from last year’s $0.15 per share. NFLX’s profit will be $347.75M for 101.31 P/E if the $0.80 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.64 actual earnings per share reported by Netflix, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 25.00% EPS growth.
Scopia Capital Management Lp, which manages about $7.11B and $5.57 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vistra Energy Corp by 414,353 shares to 6.88 million shares, valued at $125.97 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Itron Inc (NASDAQ:ITRI) by 655,383 shares in the quarter, for a total of 5.21M shares, and has risen its stake in Horizon Pharma Plc (NASDAQ:HZNP).
Among 58 analysts covering Netflix ( NASDAQ:NFLX ), 39 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 17 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. The stock of Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) earned “Outperform” rating by FBR Capital on Wednesday, January 20. The firm has “Buy” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Monday, January 22.
